basic_details.short_information: Goa Tourism Development Corporation Ltd. (GTDC) has notified 1 vacancy for the post of Manager (Marketing). Candidates can apply offline through hand delivery or by registered post or speed post to The Managing Director, Goa Tourism Development Corporation Ltd., 3rd Floor, Paryatan Bhavan, Patto Plaza, Panaji-Goa on or before 21 October 2026, with the application process starting on 30 September 2026. Applicants must hold a Degree in any faculty, Full time PGDM/MBA in Marketing, along with 5 years experience including 2 years in Tourism and hospitality sector. The notified pay for the post is

qualification.details: Essential Qualifications: | Degree in any faculty from a recognized University or equivalent. Full time Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management / Post Graduate Diploma in Management / Masters of Business Administration from a recognized University with specialisation in Marketing. Minimum 5 years work experience out of which at least 2 years should be in Tourism and hospitality Sector. Knowledge of Computers. Knowledge of Konkani. | Desirable Qualification: | Knowledge of Marathi. | Age Limit: Not exceeding 45 years. Relaxable for Government servants up to five years in accordance with instructions or orders issued by the Government from time to time.

selection_process: If the number of applications is substantially more than the number of posts advertised

GTDC shall hold a screening test for the candidates for the purpose of selection. The recruitment involves a written examination conducted as per O.M. no.1/6/83-PER (Vol.II) Pt.(a)/143 dated 14/01/2019. The examination syllabus carries a total of 100 marks distributed across General knowledge (30 marks)
Knowledge of Marketing/ sales/ Financial Management/ tourism Industry/ culture/ history of State of Goa (50 marks)

rows.details: Degree in any faculty and Full time PGDM/MBA in Marketing with experience

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted by Hand Delivery or by Registered Post or Speed Post only to the following address: The Managing Director, Goa Tourism Development Corporation Ltd., 3rd Floor, Paryatan Bhavan, Patto Plaza, Panaji-Goa. 403 001. On the top left corner of the envelope on the address side, candidates must superscribe:

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential Qualifications: Degree in any faculty from a recognized University or equivalent. Full time Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management / Post Graduate Diploma in Management / Masters of Business Administration from a recognized University with specialisation in Marketing. Minimum 5 years work experience out of which at least 2 years should be in Tourism and hospitality Sector. Knowledge of Computers. Knowledge of Konkani. Desirable Qualification: Knowledge of Marathi. Age Limit: Not exceeding 45 years. Relaxable for Government servants up to five years in accordance with instructions or orders issued by the Government from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-certified copies of Qualifications 15 Years Residential Certificate Valid Employment Card Birth Certificate Caste Certificate issued by the Government (if applicable) Certificates for participation at State/National Level competitions (if applicable) Xerox copy of letter made to employer duly acknowledged for issue of NOC (for in-service candidates)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: If the number of applications is substantially more than the number of posts advertised, GTDC shall hold a screening test for the candidates for the purpose of selection. The recruitment involves a written examination conducted as per O.M. no.1/6/83-PER (Vol.II) Pt.(a)/143 dated 14/01/2019. The examination syllabus carries a total of 100 marks distributed across General knowledge (30 marks), Knowledge of Marketing/ sales/ Financial Management/ tourism Industry/ culture/ history of State of Goa (50 marks), and Knowledge of computers (20 marks).

rows.event: Last Date for Receipt of Applications

faq.question: Q1. Who is eligible for age relaxation for the GTDC Manager (Marketing) post?
faq.answer: Age is relaxable for Government servants up to five years in accordance with the instructions or orders issued by the Government from time to time.

faq.question: Q2. What are the desirable qualifications for this position?
faq.answer: Knowledge of Marathi is listed as a desirable qualification in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What documents must be attached regarding residency and employment?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-certified copies of a 15 Years Residential Certificate and a Valid Employment Card issued by the Government.

faq.question: Q4. How is the written examination structured for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The written examination consists of General knowledge (30 marks), Knowledge of Marketing/sales/Financial Management/tourism Industry/culture/history of State of Goa (50 marks), and Knowledge of computers (20 marks), totaling 100 marks.
